examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The band as the marketing site places it: the certifications headline and lead in the media split, five certification badges in a frame grid, and a closing "See more" cell linking to the compliance page. Edit the props in the Controls panel — a band with no title renders nothing at all.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import ComplianceBadges from '@aziontech/webkit/compliance-badges'
</script>

<template>
  <ComplianceBadges
    eyebrow="Compliance"
    title="Meet your compliance requirements"
    description="Azion's certifications help customers and global partners meet a wide range of compliance requirements."
    aria-label="Compliance certifications"
    :certifications="[
      {
        label: 'SOC 2 & 3',
        badge: '/marketing-components/badges/soc.svg',
        alt: 'AICPA SOC 2 Type 2 and SOC 3 badge'
      },
      {
        label: 'PCI DSS',
        badge: '/marketing-components/badges/pci-dss.svg',
        alt: 'PCI DSS badge'
      },
      {
        label: 'LGPD',
        badge: '/marketing-components/badges/lgpd.svg',
        alt: 'LGPD badge'
      },
      {
        label: 'GDPR',
        badge: '/marketing-components/badges/gdpr.svg',
        alt: 'GDPR badge'
      },
      {
        label: 'CCPA',
        badge: '/marketing-components/badges/ccpa.svg',
        alt: 'CCPA badge'
      }
    ]"
    :primary-action="{ label: 'See more', href: '/compliance' }"
  />
</template>
